answer_1.quote: It integrates game mechanic design, code generation, and gameplay AI creation into a cohesive framework... We propose an indexing method to represent games as game mechanic graphs... We employ an LLM-based agent system that generates game code and iteratively reflects on its consistency...
answer_1.outputs: game mechanic textual descriptions, executable game code, gameplay AI policies

answer_2.quote: We use Generation Success (Succ), Executability (Exec), Embedding Consistency (ECon), Play Record Consistency (PCon) as metrics... We also define Quantiled Max Similarity (QMS) to measure novelty of generated variations.

answer_3.quote: Each record is evaluated by an LLM to score the consistency (scaled 1 to 10) between actual game play record and game description... We use claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 here to avoid the blind spots of one single LLM source.

answer_4.quote: After a manual verification on all generated games (both common and varied) in the previous task, some games are excluded from the test set for gameplay AI...
answer_4.guideline: Human reviewers manually inspected generated games for correctness and alignment with the original description.
